description: Figure 5 is a bar chart illustrating the performance gain (+%) on tasks achieved through predictive rollout search, with the gain calculated as the difference between the performance of VisuoThink with rollout search and VisuoThink without rollout search. The horizontal axis displays two distinct categories: “Geometry” and “Spatial Reasoning,” representing the two types of tasks. The vertical axis is labeled “Performance Gain (+%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 0% to approximately 30%, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5%. The chart contains two bars: the bar for “Geometry” is colored dark gray and has a height corresponding to approximately 10%, while the bar for “Spatial Reasoning” is colored light gray and is significantly taller, reaching approximately 25%. The bars are not sorted and are presented side-by-side, with no visual emphasis such as shading or outlining beyond their inherent color differentiation.
